protocol.measurement: Machine elapsed time, provider usage/cost, mechanical checks and separate semantic review. Human working time is not measured.
protocol.coverage: Exact verbatim quote anchors identify the intended fact and dependency. Missing or ambiguous targets fail task setup/coverage instead of being injected or fuzzily matched.
protocol.fairness: Same model and explicit fixed effort, one shared spend ledger, sequential provider calls, equal per-arm cap, counterbalanced paired order.
